global_attributes.title: GPCC Analysis Monthly Version 2025, precipitation in mm/month, 0.25 degree
global_attributes.summary: The GPCC Analysis Monthly Product is of much higher accuracy compared to the GPCC near real-time products mentioned above. Therefore, its application is recommended for hydrometeorological model verification and water cycle studies, e.g. in context of UNESCO, GEWEX, and GTN-H (Global Terrestrial Network for Hydrology). This analysis product is based on all stations, near real-time and non real-time, in the GPCC data base supplying data for the individual month. The GPCC Analysis Monthly Product Version 2025 covers the period from 1891 to present ; this new extended product version using the new GPCC climatology as analysis background was generated in November 2025. The data coverage per month varies from less than 10,000 to more than 52,000 stations. The GPCC Analysis Monthly Product will be updated at irregular time intervals subsequent to significant data base improvements.
